macros.doc: Use the text \= to signal assinment. This command produces this symbol in the formatted text, “←”.

macros.name: DEFAULT
macros.doc: The text \DEFAULT may be used for the condition to provide a default action.

macros.name: item
macros.doc: Use the command \item{<condition>} to create a new case label.

envs.name: algorithm
envs.doc: Use the algorithm environment to typeset algorithm code.

envs.name: FOR
envs.doc: Use the FOR environment to format a for loop and takes one argument.

envs.name: IF
envs.doc: Use the environment IF to format an if statement.

envs.name: REPEAT
envs.doc: Use the REPEAT environment to format a repeat-until loop.
